lines: The wheel of diverse states, widely flashing,
comes to be the objects of experience:
is thus the bond of nondifference —
treasury of the lights of knowing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ya eṣa vitatasphuradvividhabhāvacakrātmakaḥ parasparavibhedavānviṣayatāmupāgacchati yadekamayabhāvanāvaśata etyabhedānvayaṃ sa śaṃbhuraśivāpaho jayati bodhabhāsāṃ nidhiḥ
notes: prathiḥ + bhāvanāvaśata + ety + śivāpaha: LIVE forks held (grounds in L0)

reads_against.argmap: Who triumphs, and what is he the treasury of? → The mangala invokes the knowing-treasury: the bhāva-cakra's nondifference-bond names what the work stores — bodha-bhāsās.
c1_essence: The bhāva-cakra's nondifference-bond names the work's treasury: lights of knowing, triumphed by woe-averting Śaṃbhura.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of the treasury opened (wonder at the work's own store)
